environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS cluster in namespace 'directory-svc'. Istio service mesh 1.20 is deployed with STRICT mTLS PeerAuthentication policy at mesh level. An AuthorizationPolicy resource scoped to the directory-svc workload specifies 'action: ALLOW' with a source principal list limited to 'cluster.local/ns/hr-portal/sa/hr-frontend' and 'cluster.local/ns/onboarding/sa/onboard-worker'. Additionally, an EnvoyFilter resource attached to the sidecar applies a Lua filter on the inbound listener that performs request normalization: it URL-decodes all query parameter values, strips any character not matching [a-zA-Z0-9@._\-\s] from the 'department' and 'role' parameter values before forwarding to the application container. The EnvoyFilter Lua script specifically targets the route matching '/api/v1/users/search'.

config.envoy_filter: Lua inbound filter on /api/v1/users/search: URL-decodes then strips chars not in [a-zA-Z0-9@._\-\s] from 'department' and 'role' query params
config.network_policy: Calico NetworkPolicy allowing ingress only from namespaces hr-portal and onboarding on port 8080
